jobs.title: VP Portfolio Manager / Fund Manager  – Fixed Income
jobs.description:
On behalf of our client, a well-established asset management firm in Jeddah, Swisslinx Middle East is searching for an experienced VP Capital Markets – Fixed Income to join their asset management department in Jeddah or Riyadh.

You will be working with a team of experienced professionals and reporting to the department Head.

The successful candidate should demonstrate the following:
• 5-10+ years of Fixed Income portfolio management / fund management experience within asset management industry ideally with focus on GCC / global markets
• Solid experience of at least 5 years in MENA Fixed Income portfolios
• CFA or CAIA will be a plus
• Arabic is a plus but not mandatory

Our client offers a a solid working environment, competitive remuneration and room for long-term career development.

Please note, only relevant candidates will be contacted
